title: Published ports
description: Container ports published on a server's network interfaces. Docker bypasses ufw for these, so a firewall that looks active does not cover them.
probeNote: A failed check is reported as could not confirm, never as closed: many routers block a server from dialling its own public address.
emptyTitle: Nothing of yours is published to the internet
emptyBody: No container on this server listens on a public address without a restriction.
rulesUnreadable: The host firewall chain could not be read: {{reason}}

outside.could_not_confirm: Could not confirm from this host

dialog.title: Restrict port {{port}}
dialog.description: Only the sources you list can connect. Everyone else is dropped, including the internet.
dialog.sourcesHint: One IP or CIDR per line, for example your other servers
dialog.localContainers: Also allow containers on this server
